title: Taco Dragon Infinity
description: A vibrant surreal scene shows a green and orange dragon with taco scales forming an infinity loop. A woman in a flowing red cape and dress rides the dragon while holding a bottle, with a food truck labeled 'Tacos El Fusion' visible through the loop and giant tacos with lime on a yellow napkin in the foreground.
prompt: A vibrant psychedelic scene featuring a large green and orange dragon covered in taco and chili patterns, twisted into a glowing infinity symbol. A woman wearing a dramatic red cape and dress rides atop the dragon holding a bottle. Inside the loop is a colorful food truck that says 'Tacos El Fusion'. In the foreground are two large detailed tacos on a yellow napkin with a lime wedge. Floating smiley face bubbles and swirling colorful patterns fill the background in a surreal fantasy style.
